values.note: $38 a night for every site (standard and RV nonelectric), the same in the 2026, 2027 and 2028 rate tables; extra vehicles pay a per-vehicle nightly fee. Senior and Access pass holders get 50% off their own single site.

fees.source: https://www.recreation.gov/api/camps/campgrounds/234033/rates (Peak Season 2026-01-01 to 2026-12-31 and 2027: RV NONELECTRIC and STANDARD NONELECTRIC $38) + campground notice on extra vehicles, read 2026-10-20

discounts.source: https://www.fs.usda.gov/r08/florida/recreation/clearwater-lake-recreation-area ('Annual Senior Pass, Lifetime Senior Pass and Access Pass holders receive a 50% discount on the fee for a single campsite occupied by the passholder at ... Clearwater Lake Campground'), last updated 2026-05-20, read 2026-10-20

hookups.source: https://www.recreation.gov/api/camps/campgrounds/234033 (Facilities: 'No hookups are available.'; all 38 catalog sites STANDARD NONELECTRIC), read 2026-10-20

values.note: Dishwashing station in both loops; ice and firewood sold; canoe rentals at the entrance station. Supplies in Paisley, a mile away.

facilities.source: https://www.recreation.gov/api/camps/campgrounds/234033 (description: flush toilets, showers, dish washing station; amenities: Drinking Water, Dump Station, Flush Toilets, Showers, Ice Machine, Firewood, Canoe Rentals) + https://www.fs.usda.gov/r08/florida/recreation/clearwater-lake-recreation-area (amenities: Drinking water, Flush toilets, Showers), read 2026-10-20

values.note: Stay limit 14 consecutive days in any 30. recreation.gov lists a 2-night weekend and 3-night holiday minimum, both marked 'soft' (not always enforced), so neither is recorded as a rule. The gate locks at 6 p.m. (March-October) and 4 p.m. (November-March); late arrivals finish check-in at the gatehouse next morning or are charged as a no-show.

booking.source: https://www.recreation.gov/api/camps/campgrounds/234033 (facility_rules maxStay 14 per rolling 30 days, minWeekendStay 2 'soft', minHolidayWeekendStay 3 'soft'; gate notice) + https://www.fs.usda.gov/r08/florida/recreation/clearwater-lake-recreation-area ('Campsites are available for reservation at Recreation.gov'; 14 consecutive days in a 30-day period), read 2026-10-20

values.note: 38 reservable nonelectric sites, all back-in, the longest listing a 40-ft max vehicle length. Limit 2 vehicles (campers included), 2 tents and 5 people per site.

sites.source: https://www.recreation.gov/api/search/campsites?fq=asset_id%3A234033 (38 campsites, Driveway Entry Back-In, Max Vehicle Length up to 40) + campground notice on site limits, read 2026-10-20

summary: Confirmed $38, no hookups (water/sewer now recorded false), Senior/Access 50% discount (named for this campground on the USFS page). Added facilities, reservable on rec.gov with a 14-night max (soft minimums in the note only), 38 back-in sites up to 40 ft. Not stated: season (rate seasons are calendar years), booking window for individual sites, fcfs. USFS page lists 'Drinking water' but its template line says potable water is not available; rec.gov also lists Drinking Water, so potable_water recorded true.
